opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: Maximum grant £20,000 (New Projects and Commissions; Acquisitions and Collections; Long-Term Research); £5,000 (Conferences, Lectures and Publications); £2,500 (Research and Travel)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non-profit organisations (established and operating in a non-profit capacity for at least 12 months) for exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, non-commercial publications, acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing and display. Individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators can apply under the Research and Travel category. Applications from individuals independently wishing to develop their own practice are not accepted.
opportunities.summary: Henry Moore Grants support the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, and fund research that expands the appreciation of sculpture. Categories: New Projects and Commissions; Acquisitions and Collections; Conferences, Lectures and Publications; Long-Term Research; and Research and Travel grants for individuals. Applications are considered four times per year.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Expenses allocation for travel and subsistence: UK up to £600, Europe up to £700, Rest of world up to £1,000; plus accommodation in Leeds or Hertfordshire for the duration of the fellowship

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics or curators working on historic and contemporary sculpture (Visiting Research Fellowships); researchers whose interests lie in Henry Moore (fellowships at Studios & Gardens); artists to develop their practice through research (Artist Research Fellowships); established scholars for six-week Senior Fellowships.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enabling artists and researchers to spend a month using the Henry Moore Institute's research facilities in Leeds or Hertfordshire, including accommodation, travel and subsistence expenses. Applications are currently closed for 2026/27; the next round opens in spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Dissertation Prize
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to BA and MA students of all disciplines.
opportunities.summary: Each year the Henry Moore Institute awards two prizes for outstanding writing on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture. Submissions for the 2026 prize will open in autumn.
